name: print-bench
description: Design and upgrade 3D prints with Claude Code: OpenSCAD parts one STL per colour, mesh checks, a Print Bench preview page with sizes and a measure tool, studio renders, colour-assigned 3MF projects for Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer, 3D modelling skills and agents, and MCP servers that let Claude design, slice and drive a printer.

python.title: Python command
python.description: How to start Python 3.8 or later: python3 on a Mac or Linux, python on Windows

design_dir.title: Designs folder
design_dir.description: Where Claude saves your OpenSCAD designs, STLs and sliced files (it writes only here)

spoolman_url.title: Spoolman address (optional)
spoolman_url.description: e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7912, so every slice says whether a spool has enough left. Leave empty if you don't use Spoolman

workshop_url.title: Workshop address (optional)
workshop_url.description: The Workshop page next to your Klipper/Moonraker printer (python tools/workshop.py), e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8090. Needed only for the printer tools

your_name.title: Your name
your_name.description: Shown in Workshop's activity log next to what you do
